DgramSocket.constructor.onmessage: Added as a listener for the `'message'` event, if provided.

DgramSocket.addMembership.group: The multicast group address to join.
DgramSocket.addMembership.iface: The interface to join on; joins on all applicable interfaces when omitted or `null`.

DgramSocket.addSourceSpecificMembership.source: The source address to accept datagrams from.
DgramSocket.addSourceSpecificMembership.group: The multicast group address to join.
DgramSocket.addSourceSpecificMembership.iface: The interface to join on; joins on all applicable interfaces when omitted or `null`.

DgramSocket.bind.port: The local port to bind to; `0` picks an available port automatically.
DgramSocket.bind.address: The local address to bind to; binds to all interfaces when omitted or empty.
DgramSocket.bind.onlistening: Added as a one-time listener for the `'listening'` event, if provided.

DgramSocket.close.onclose: Added as a one-time listener for the `'close'` event, if provided.

DgramSocket.connect.port: The remote port to connect to; must be between `1` and `65535`.
DgramSocket.connect.address: The remote address to connect to; uses the loopback address when omitted or empty.
DgramSocket.connect.onconnect: Added as a one-time listener for the `'connect'` event, if provided.

DgramSocket.dropMembership.group: The multicast group address to leave.
DgramSocket.dropMembership.iface: The interface to leave on; leaves on all applicable interfaces when omitted or `null`.

DgramSocket.dropSourceSpecificMembership.source: The source address that was passed to `addSourceSpecificMembership()`.
DgramSocket.dropSourceSpecificMembership.group: The multicast group address to leave.
DgramSocket.dropSourceSpecificMembership.iface: The interface to leave on; leaves on all applicable interfaces when omitted or `null`.

DgramSocket.send.msg: The data to send — a string, `Buffer`, typed array, `DataView`, or an array of these sent as a single datagram.
DgramSocket.send.offset: Byte offset into `msg` to start sending from; only valid when `msg` is not an array.
DgramSocket.send.length: Number of bytes of `msg` to send; only valid when `msg` is not an array.
DgramSocket.send.port: The remote port; omit when the socket is connected.
DgramSocket.send.address: The remote address; omit when the socket is connected.
DgramSocket.send.cb: Called once the datagram has been handed off to the operating system.

DgramSocket.setMulticastInterface.iface: The address of the interface to use for outgoing multicast datagrams.

DgramSocket.setRecvBufferSize.size: The buffer size in bytes; must be at least `1`.

DgramSocket.setSendBufferSize.size: The buffer size in bytes; must be at least `1`.

createSocket.onmessage: Added as a listener for the `'message'` event, if provided.
